correctness.rationale: The graded coproduct calculation in the primary source separates the fresh exterior-power components. Lemma 4.7's two coefficient-separation steps require only linear independence of the chosen degree-two vectors, so binomial(q,2) defects can be packed into q free generators. Lemma 4.9 and Lemma 4.10 similarly require independence in the central degree-three component, allowing binomial(q,3) defects to be packed. The source's remaining rank-two extension and existential-closedness step are unchanged. Substitution into Theorem 3.3 then yields the displayed O(m^4) witness bound.

value.rationale: The strict-envelope bound is a central quantitative ingredient of the new model-companion proof and is highlighted in the paper's introduction. Systematically exploiting the full exterior-power capacity reduces the envelope from quadratic to n+O(n^(2/3)) and the propagated finite-obstruction degree from eight to four. This is a substantial structural improvement to a natural bound explicitly flagged as nonoptimal.
